title: agent-memory-site chunk
description: One retrieval-ready chunk emitted into chunks.jsonl. Stable across reorders; provenance preserved end-to-end.

chunk_id.description: Stable identifier: <doc_id>#<heading-slug>. Reordering the source note does NOT change this id.

doc_id.description: Slug-form id of the source note. Matches the note's filename without extension.

title.description: Title of the source note (already redacted in --mode redacted).

heading_path.description: Breadcrumb of headings for this chunk. Starts with the note title, ends with the section heading. Consecutive duplicates are collapsed.

type.description: Note type (project | decision | procedure | fact | person | handoff | daily | instruction | ...).

text.description: Plain-text body of the chunk. Code fences stripped; markdown punctuation normalized to whitespace. Already redacted in --mode redacted.

html.description: Self-contained <section> HTML for direct embedding. Uses the 5-char HTML escape (&<>"'). Always wrap in a sandboxed container if you trust input from third parties.

source_path.description: Forward-slash relative path to the source note within the vault. In --mode public, this is included; in --mode redacted, it MAY be dropped depending on the manifest config.

canonical_url.description: Site-relative URL to the rendered note page.

updated.description: ISO-8601 last-update timestamp. Sourced from frontmatter `updated`, then `date`, then file mtime.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp. Sourced from frontmatter `created_at`, then file birthtime.

tags.description: Lowercase tags from frontmatter `tags`. Already redacted in --mode redacted.

keywords.description: Optional. From frontmatter `keywords`. Stronger search match weight than tags.

tokens.description: Approximate token count (text.length / 4 heuristic; real tokenizer planned for 0.4).

content_hash.description: Truncated SHA-256 of the chunk text. Stable across rebuilds; safe to cache embeddings against this.

visibility.description: Chunk-level visibility, inherited from the source note. Downstream RAG can filter on this.

sensitivity.description: Chunk-level sensitivity, inherited from the source note.

supersedes.description: Optional. doc_ids this chunk's note replaces. Prefer this chunk over those.

superseded_by.description: Optional. doc_id of the note that supersedes this one. If set, downstream retrievers SHOULD de-prioritize this chunk.
